Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia un tr.e: The sign shown warns of a dangerous stretch of road because of a dip in the roadbed.

Il segnale raffigurato preannuncia una c.e: The sign shown warns in advance of a reserved lane for entry into an airport.

Il segnale raffigurato consente ad un mo.e: The sign shown allows a motorcycle to pass a bus.

In presenza del segnale raffigurato è se.e: In the presence of the sign shown, forced removal of the vehicle is always provided for.

Il segnale raffigurato indica presenza d.e: The sign shown indicates the presence of a depot with vehicles for mechanical street cleaning probably coming out.

Il segnale raffigurato impone di arresta.e: The sign shown requires you to stop because passage is prohibited.

Quando il vigile si dispone con le bracc.e: When the traffic officer stands with arms outstretched facing our direction as shown, passage is prohibited.

Sono previste sanzioni per chi, pur face.e: Penalties are provided for anyone who, even while using a seat belt, alters it or hinders its normal operation.

Soccorrere un ferito della strada non è.e: Helping an injured road casualty is not a legal obligation, only a moral duty.
Soccorrere un ferito della strada non è.ar: مساعدة مصاب في حادثة طريق مش إلزام قانوني، ده واجب أخلاقي بس.

Non è obbligatorio soccorrere un ferito.e: It is not obligatory to help an injured road casualty, so as not to endanger your own safety.
Non è obbligatorio soccorrere un ferito.ar: مساعدة مصاب في حادثة طريق مش إجبارية، عشان متعرّضش أمانك للخطر.

Durante un intervento di primo soccorso.e: During first aid, you must never touch the injured person if the police have not yet arrived.
Durante un intervento di primo soccorso.ar: وإنت بتعمل إسعافات أولية، عمرك ما تلمس المصاب طول ما البوليس لسه موصلش.

Se un infortunato della strada ha una fe.e: If a road casualty has a bleeding wound, you must not cover it, to help the bleeding stop on its own.
Se un infortunato della strada ha una fe.ar: لو مصاب في حادثة طريق عنده جرح بينزف، متغطيهوش عشان الدم يقف لوحده.
